settings.heading: Our story
settings.body:
Chidi Abara and I started Thorne & Abara in 2015 to do three kinds of work well: estate planning, probate and trust administration, and the law a small business needs. There are six of us now, in Portland, with a meeting room across the river in Vancouver.

You will know who is handling your matter, and what it costs, before you sign anything. The first meeting is 30 minutes by video and costs $150, credited to your plan if you go ahead.
